thread:
Maya: heads-up — CedarHealth on-prem cutover set for 2026-04-07. Need owners for last-mile firewall, artifact transfer (air-gapped), certs, KMS/HSM, and the preflight smoke list. Please ack and state blockers by EOD.

Danielle - NetEng: I'll own firewall & DNS fallback. Blocker: cedar infra needs exact egress IPs or FQDNs; they're strict about outbound allowlists. Also their resolver rewrites external names — might need local stub resolver.

Ryan T: I'll own artifact bundle and checksums. Question: are we delivering an encrypted offline bundle or will Cedar pull from a staging S3 mirror? If it's offline, I need transfer window and USB logistics.

Nate SRE: I'll take import tooling and the bastion jumpbox. If USB handoff, our ingest pipeline needs the tarball sha256 and a signed manifest. Prep ETA: 12h after manifest arrives.

Paul (Solutions): Cedar said maintenance window only on Wed 23:00-02:00. If network changes must occur then. I'll prepare a step-by-step rollback plan and an ops runbook draft.

Danielle - NetEng: Minimal firewall policy for them to apply (example):
```
# allow control plane
allow tcp 10.8.32.0/24 -> 172.20.5.0/24 443
# DNS to our resolver pool
allow udp 10.8.32.0/24 -> 54.210.48.12 53
```
They insist on IPs, not FQDNs. I'll collate full list.

Maya: @Danielle please produce the IP list + short fallback plan. Also @Ryan confirm whether bundle is encrypted with our KMS or theirs.

Ryan T: Confirmed: it's an encrypted bundle using Cedar's CloudHSM-managed keys. I need CloudHSM access creds to run a decryption compatibility test. Manifest (name, sha256, size, encryption header) will be posted to secure drive in ~2h.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline cedar-onprem-cutover (branch: onprem/cedar-cutover) — checks passing :white_check_mark:

Nate SRE: KMS/HSM note: if Cedar's HSM is used, we must validate PKCS#11 driver compatibility in the airgapped runtime. That alters cert provisioning steps.

Paul (Solutions): Cedar wants a signed attestation once certs rotate and before going live. Legal will review the attestation template; looping in @legal-bot.

legal-bot: Received attestation request. I'll route to compliance; expect initial feedback within 24h.

Maya: Owners recap: Networking -> @Danielle - NetEng; Artifact manifest & KMS test -> @Ryan T; Import & bastion -> @Nate SRE; Runbook & rollback -> @Paul (Solutions); Legal attestation -> @legal-bot. Please ack and list any non-trivial blockers.

Danielle - NetEng: ack. Non-trivial: cedar's network team only applies firewall changes inside the maintenance window and requires ticket with exact rule snippets 48h prior.

Nate SRE: ack. Non-trivial: our USB ingest tool needs a patch to validate bundles >100GB; may add 45-60m.

Ryan T: ack. Non-trivial: CloudHSM creds pending from Cedar sec team; could delay cert finalization.

Paul (Solutions): ack. Non-trivial: attestation template may need custom language for their auditors.

Maya: Thanks. I'll assemble the preflight checklist and publish the runbook here by EOD. If anything blocks earlier, DM me. :thumbsup:
